style.backgroundSystem: three systems: pure seamless white #FFFFFF for hero and lineups; mint-aqua flat lay #BFE3D0 to #CBE5D2 with soft ripples for still lifes; white subway tile and matte marble #F2F1EF and #EDEDEA for scenes; cream #F4EFE6 for number tiles
style.direction: fresh clinical clean beauty for oral care: white studio infographics, mint-aqua still lifes and real bathroom counter scenes, product always the single hero
style.iconSystem: 1.5px line-stroke icons inside frosted cards or white hexagon badges; ingredients as circular photo pins
style.lightingSystem: large soft top light with short feathered shadows, never hard or moody; frontal soft window light for model scenes; shadowless top light for flat lays
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: fresh clinical clean beauty for oral care across the whole set. The product is the single hero on one of three backgrounds: pure seamless white #FFFFFF, mint-aqua flat lay #BFE3D0 to #CBE5D2 with soft ripples, or a real bathroom counter of white subway tile and matte marble #F2F1EF and #EDEDEA warmed by light wood. Cream #F4EFE6 hosts number tiles. Soft top light with short feathered shadows, never hard or moody; frontal soft window light for people. A white paste smear is the recurring texture motif with fresh mint leaves and transparent droplets. Typography pairs a bold sans headline with a serif italic emphasis word in near-black #1A1A1A; claims live on frosted translucent cards with 1.5px line icons, size messages on ribbon bars. One message per image, flavor variants told through whole-fruit props on per-flavor pastel grounds, and all social-proof numbers come from verified facts. No other categories, no unlisted SKUs, no fabricated certifications, no brand marks.
noDrift: no other product categories in frame
no hardcoded view counts or sales numbers
no neon colors or dark moody grounds
no real brand marks or packaging copy
style.presentationRules: one message per image, tube standing or lying at a 45-degree angle consistently, whole-fruit still-life props per flavor, social-proof numbers only from verified facts
style.surfaceSystem: white paste smear as the recurring texture motif; matte white marble, subway tile, water-color plane, light wood props, glass highlights
style.temperature: cool-neutral with cream and light-wood warmth buffers
style.typography: bold sans-serif headline paired with a serif italic emphasis word in near-black #1A1A1A; claims live on frosted translucent cards, size messages on ribbon bars
